title: Two Roommates Deciding Who Walks the Dog
script: Tara: [amused] Joko, we've had Bimo for three weeks now, and somehow we still haven't agreed on a proper walking schedule.
Joko: [laughing] I know, we've just been walking him whenever one of us happens to notice he's staring at the leash.
Tara: [practical] That's not really sustainable, though. Yesterday nobody noticed until nine at night, and he seemed genuinely miserable by then.
Joko: [guilty] Fair point. I actually felt bad about that too, although I assumed you had already taken him out earlier.
Tara: [gently] See, that's exactly the problem, we're both assuming the other person handled it, so sometimes nobody does.
Joko: [thinking] Okay, let's actually fix this properly. What if mornings are always mine, since I already wake up early for work anyway?
Tara: [agreeing] That works well, because I'm barely functional before eight, and Bimo deserves better than a half-asleep walker.
Joko: [continuing] Then evenings could alternate, since our work schedules change depending on the week, that part feels harder to fix permanently.
Tara: [suggesting] What if we just text each other by six every evening, confirming who's walking him that specific night?
Joko: [nodding] That's simple enough that we'll actually remember to do it, unlike our last three failed schedule attempts.
Tara: [laughing] True, remember the color-coded calendar? It lasted exactly four days before we both forgot it existed.
Joko: [chuckling] Don't remind me. Okay, mornings mine, evenings decided by text, and weekends we split however feels fair that week.
Tara: [pleased] Sounds reasonable. Also, can we agree that whoever walks him also refills his water bowl afterward?
Joko: [agreeing] Definitely, that keeps getting forgotten too, and he ends up staring at an empty bowl like we've betrayed him.
Tara: [smiling] He really does give that exact look. Okay, I think this plan might actually survive longer than four days.
Joko: [determined] Let's write it on the fridge this time, next to the chore chart, so we see it constantly.
Tara: [warmly] Good idea. Honestly, having him has been wonderful, we just need to get better at the logistics part.
Joko: [smiling] Agreed completely. Speaking of which, he's staring at the leash right now, so that's my morning walk starting early.
Tara: [laughing] Go on then, before he starts making that disappointed sound he does when we ignore him too long.

quiz.question: How long have Tara and Joko had their dog, Bimo?
quiz.explanation: Tara mentions they've had Bimo for three weeks.

quiz.question: What happened the night before this conversation?
options: Nobody walked him until nine at night

options: He already wakes up early for work anyway
Tara refuses to wake up early ever
quiz.explanation: Joko takes mornings because he already wakes up early for work anyway.

quiz.question: How will they decide who walks the dog in the evening?
options: Texting each other by six to confirm
quiz.explanation: They agree to text each other by six each evening to confirm who is walking him.

quiz.explanation: They agree that whoever walks him also refills his water bowl afterward.
